name: camping_common_names_v1
scope: LILA only; familiar fine classes coexist with broader residual categories; no automatic hierarchy coarsening
notes: wild_boar is an application group for Eurasian wild pig and African bushpig; original species retained in source provenance.
pig is ambiguous pig; never assume domestic from an unspecified source label.
Small antelope maps to the common antelope group without using the old Antilopinae mapping.
No wolf source class is available.
Keep tree_shrew, chevrotain, galago, buffalo and hyena: these were missing from the initial overview and cannot safely be renamed as rodents, antelopes, monkeys, domestic cattle or dogs.
Civet and pheasant are application common-name groups, not assertions of a single biological species.
